title: Battle of Sarhū
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sarhū", at revision 1370273817, opens: "The Battle of Sarhū refers to a series of battles between the Later Jin dynasty and the Ming dynasty and their Joseon allies in 1619. The battle is notable for the heavy use of cavalry by the Later Jin in defeating Ming and Joseon forces equipped with hand cannons, cannons, and matchlocks." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q488547, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle between Ming and Later Jin (predecessor of the Qing dynasty) in 1619". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
